text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- At least Z$68 million has been disbursed to 86 Zimbabwean commercial and small-scale cattle producers out of a Z$300 million loan facility provided by Standard Chartered Bank and Old Mutual to help rebuild the national herd.
- Zimbabwe's parliament sat on Tuesday to consider supplementary estimates of expenditure for various government ministeries whose original votes for the 1996/97 fiscal year were inadequate.

- Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare Minister Florence Chitauro has denied that she was intimidated into leaving out some individuals in her probe into the alleged abuse of the country's War Victims Compensation Fund.

- A parliamentary committee investigating the home affairs ministry on Tuesday reported acute manpower shortages resulting in lack of financial control in the ministry and unchecked corruption among officers in some of its departments.
